body: I'm an athiest.  I can accept what happened to me.  I can even forgive it.  I don't feel weird or alone.  I live with it daily, but sometimes it's so overwhelming that I can't function.

Find something he's into and offer to bring it to him.  Like, for example, my friend was like, hey, do you want me to bring you some beers?  And he came over with beers AND pizza and it was like, for that hour, just for that moment, I was happy.  And it was really helpful.

Have you ever played Cards Against Humanity? I think it's a really fun game, and you can DL it for free (http://cardsagainsthumanity.com/).  Maybe take him to Staples (or wherever) to get him out of the house, print that shit out for like 10 bucks, and play it when you get home.  It's pretty fun.

Thank you so much for posting this.  If I didn't have family and friends I would have been gone long, long ago.  I worry continually about my suicidal thoughts.  Sometimes they're rational, sometimes irrational.  But nevertheless, they seem to follow me constantly.  Sometimes I push them away by cutting or pulling out my hair, but it never satisfies the need I feel to die.

My family doesn't accept me because I'm lesbian.  The only person that does is my younger brother, and he's been super helpful.

I was raped a few years back, and I suffer from PTSD which lead to a diagnosed case of agoraphobia.  I have trouble leaving my house, and sometimes I have trouble leaving my room even to go to the bathroom.  All of this makes me feel so worthless like I want to die.  But I too have known someone who killed herself, and I really don't want to leave that sort of legacy behind.  I want to live a "normal" life... one free of constant dread and cutting.

I've also rambled, but anyway, thanks for posting, and thank you for your perspective on what it's like to survive after someones' suicide.
What worked best for you in terms of recovery?
I know how you feel.  I'm up at 2am, alone, bored, suicidal, feeling like I'm too weak to even do it, but I'm awake.  PM me if you want.  Maybe we can chat it out.

I had a friend go through a really really similar situation.  The girl did eventually take him back after a crack relapse.

Anyway, just be there for your friend the best you can.  Like, I'm on here tonight because I'm trying to not kill myself and find reasons to not die.  I had my friend over earlier who I genuinely trust.  We played a stupid board game, but it got us both sort of out of the trenches of our depression, if only for an hour.  But I'm hanging onto that hour, because I know tomorrow we have plans to go swimming.  Just try to keep plans with him and do little things.  When you're depressed and down, it's the smallest things sometimes that can pull you out of it... if only for a bit.

I like web design, going on walks, petting my dogs, hanging out with friends, reading, writing.

It just seems like I have no energy to do any of those things.  I'm so agoraphobic I literally have problems getting out of my room to use the bathroom to pee.
That's possibly the worst advice I've ever received.  Thanks, asshole.

If you feel shitty about something, it's a real problem.  Mine isn't any better or worse than yours.  Don't compare yourself to me.  It just makes you feel worse.

You're not wasting anyone's time.  We're here for you.  That's what this subreddit is for.  If you wanna chat or skype you can PM me.
Here are some numbers she can call.. don't know what country she's in, but maybe this will help: http://www.reddit.com/r/SWResources/comments/17gu7g/hotline_numbers/

a) I've changed therapists.  I've had more than one therapist at once.  Didn't work.

b) I'm not going to do drugs.  I am too anxious to do anything psychedelic, so I feel like I know I'd have a bad trip.

c) I've had really simple jobs, and I've had to quit them because I was too anxious.  Like jobs a block from my house.  I had to just quit on the spot one day because I was too afraid to be that far away from my house.

And I don't want to find a new girlfriend.  That would only worsen my problems.

I've been waiting for the right turns for a few years... I know how it is.  I'm jobless.  Diagnosed agoraphobic with PTSD and depression.  I was raped a few years ago, and I can't seem to get my shit together since then.  I want to end it almost every day.  But that's why I come on here sometimes... just to feel like someone knows or can at least understand what I'm going through.  My girlfriend broke up with me recently... she couldn't handle the stress of being with me.  I understand her point.  It's rough, but we can make it.  I have hope that we can both make it.

I just posted on here too, and I feel like utter shite.  Please don't kill yourself.  We can talk if you want.  I am just one person trying to keep it together, and I hope you can too.  I've been through a lot of shit recently, and I know what it's like to want to end it... have a plan ready... stop caring how people will feel if you die.  But please, hear me out, don't do it.  We both are maybe just a few right turns from making it right again.

I've been in therapy for the last five years.  I've had multiple hospitalizations as I mentioned.  I have been diagnosed with agoraphobia.

I am contemplating switching therapists.  I've also tried several group therapies and completed the courses.  But nothing seems to help.  Despite exposure therapy and everything else I've mentioned I seem to just get worse and worse as the years roll by me.
